We offer a variety of banking services including checking and savings accounts, loans, credit cards, investment services, and online banking.
What product or service do you need help with?
We offer various loan products including personal, home, auto, and education loans. You can apply online, visit any branch, or call our loan center at 1-800-LOAN-NOW.
Current interest rates vary by loan type and credit profile. Use our online loan calculator or speak with a loan officer for personalized rates.
Loan eligibility depends on income, credit score, and other factors. Start an application online for a preliminary decision or schedule a consultation with a loan specialist.
You can transfer money between your accounts, to other SecureBank customers, or to external accounts through online banking or our mobile app.
For domestic transfers, use online banking. For international wire transfers, you may need to visit a branch with proper identification.
Bill payments can be set up as one-time or recurring payments in your online banking. Most payments process within 1-2 business days.
To open a new account, you can apply online, visit any branch with identification, or call our new accounts department at 1-800-NEW-ACCT.
We offer checking, savings, money market, and certificate of deposit accounts. Compare features online or speak with a banker.
To update your personal information or close an account, please visit a branch with valid ID or call customer service during business hours.
You can find the nearest ATM or branch using our website's locator tool or mobile app. Most ATMs are available 24/7.
Branch hours vary by location. Typically, branches are open Monday-Friday 9AM-5PM and Saturday 9AM-1PM. Use our branch locator for specific hours.
SecureBank ATMs have no fees for customers. Withdrawal limits are $500 daily for debit cards, but you can request higher limits at a branch.
You can log in to your online banking account using your username and password. If you're having trouble logging in, try resetting your password or contacting customer service.
If you're having trouble logging in, make sure you're using the correct username and password. You can reset your password using the 'Forgot Password' link on the login page.
If you're having login issues, use the 'Forgot Password' link or call our technical support at 1-888-DIGITAL for assistance.
To reset your password, click on the 'Forgot Password' link on the login page and follow the instructions.
Our online banking and mobile app allow you to manage accounts, transfer funds, pay bills, and deposit checks remotely.
For enhanced security, we offer two-factor authentication and biometric login options. Enable these features in your security settings.
If you suspect fraud, call our 24/7 fraud hotline immediately: 1-888-0000-00. We'll secure your accounts and investigate any unauthorized activity.
For security, never share passwords or one-time codes. We'll never ask for this information via email or text.
Monitor your accounts regularly and set up transaction alerts. Report any suspicious emails claiming to be from SecureBank to phishing@securebank.com.
We offer investment services through SecureBank Wealth Management. Schedule a consultation with a financial advisor at 1-800-INVEST-8.
Our investment products include IRAs, mutual funds, CDs, and brokerage services. Risk levels and returns vary by product.
For retirement planning, we offer Traditional and Roth IRAs, as well as rollover services from employer plans like 401(k)s.
Our customer service is available 24/7 at 1-888-SECURE-BANK. For specific departments, visit our Contact Us page online.
You can reach us by phone, secure message in online banking, or by visiting any branch. Response times vary by channel.
For general inquiries: 1-888-SECURE-BANK. Lost/stolen cards: 1-888-SECURE-00. Fraud: 1-888-FRAUD-00. Technical support: 1-888-DIGITAL.
Current interest rates are updated daily on our website. Savings accounts earn 0.05% APY, 12-month CDs earn 0.50% APY (rates subject to change).
Mortgage and loan rates vary based on creditworthiness, loan amount, and term. Get a personalized rate quote by applying online.
For the most current rates on all products, visit our Rates page or speak with a banker. Rates are subject to change without notice.
You can view and download statements for the past 7 years in your online banking. Go to Accounts > Statements & Documents.
Tax documents like 1099-INT forms are available by January 31st each year. Download them from online banking or we'll mail them to your address on file.
For duplicate statements or archived documents not available online, visit a branch with ID or call customer service. Fees may apply for paper copies.

Minimum balance requirements vary by account type. Most checking accounts require $500, while savings accounts require $300. Premium accounts may have higher requirements.
If your balance falls below the minimum, you may incur a monthly fee. You can waive this fee by setting up direct deposit or maintaining an electronic recurring transfer.
Contact us at 1-888-SECURE-BANK to discuss account options that fit your needs, including zero-balance accounts for select customers.
Overdraft protection links your checking account to a savings account or credit line to prevent declined transactions. Set it up in your online banking.
If you overdraw without protection, a $35 fee applies per transaction. Overdraft protection fees are $15. Linked accounts have no additional charge.
You can opt out of overdraft coverage in your account settings, or link accounts for automatic transfers when needed.
Domestic wire transfers cost $15, while international wires are $45. Rush processing is available for an additional $25.
Some accounts offer monthly free wires. Check your account features in online banking or call customer service to learn about your benefit.
Military members and premium account holders may qualify for waived wire fees. Verify your eligibility at a branch or online.
With mobile check deposit, simply photograph the front and back of your check in our app. Funds are typically available within 1-2 business days.
First-time mobile deposits may take longer to clear. ATM deposits are available 24/7 at most of our locations with instant availability for most account types.
Check deposits through ATM or mobile have daily limits of $5,000 and $2,500 respectively. These reset daily.
Our debit cards include zero-liability fraud protection, purchase protection, and emergency cash access worldwide. You can also set transaction limits.
If your card is lost or stolen, call our 24/7 hotline: 1-888-SECURE-00. We'll freeze it immediately and send a replacement within 3-5 business days.
Debit card replacements cost $15, but it's free if you're replacing a damaged card we provided. Rush delivery is $25.
International transactions incur a 2.5% foreign transaction fee plus applicable currency conversion rates. Premium accounts may have reduced fees (1%).
Use ATMs affiliated with our network abroad to avoid fees. Check our website for partner banks in your destination country.
Our travel card offers zero foreign transaction fees and competitive exchange rates. Apply online or visit a branch for details.
Set financial goals in your online banking and use our automated savings tools to reach them. Round-up features automatically transfer change to savings.
Our High-Yield Savings Account earns 0.45% APY with no monthly fees. Funds are FDIC insured up to $250,000.
Create dedicated savings buckets for different goals like vacation, emergency fund, or home down payment. Transfer funds automatically each payday.
Our free budgeting tools categorize your spending, set spending limits, and send alerts when you approach limits. Access them in your online banking.
Use our Spending Insights feature to see where your money goes. Customize categories and get recommendations to reduce spending.
Connect your SecureBank accounts to view all spending in one dashboard. Budget alerts help you stay on track with financial goals.
Certificates of Deposit (CDs) offer fixed rates for locked-in periods: 3-month (0.20% APY), 1-year (0.50% APY), 5-year (1.50% APY).
Early withdrawal from a CD results in a penalty equal to 150 days of earned interest. After maturity, your CD automatically renews unless you opt out.
Our No-Penalty CD lets you withdraw without penalty after 7 days. It earns 0.30% APY—perfect for flexibility combined with better rates.
Money Market Accounts combine features of savings and checking with competitive rates (0.40% APY). Limited check writing (6 per month) keeps fees low.
Minimum opening balance is $2,500. No monthly maintenance fees if balance stays above $1,000. Write unlimited checks online or at branches.
Withdraw up to 6 times monthly without penalty. Additional withdrawals cost $10 each. ATM and debit card access available 24/7.
Our Student Checking Account has no monthly fees, no minimum balance, and no overdraft fees for qualifying students. Opens with just a student ID.
Get a free student debit card, unlimited ATM access, and mobile banking. Includes identity theft protection specific to student needs.
Transition smoothly to our regular checking at graduation. No new application needed. Student benefits continue through your grace period.
Designate beneficiaries for your accounts so funds transfer directly upon your passing, bypassing probate. Update them in online banking or at a branch.
You can name multiple beneficiaries and specify percentages. Review your designations annually and after major life events.
For comprehensive estate planning with power of attorney and trusts, schedule a consultation with our financial advisor team at 1-800-WEALTH.
Our Business Checking Account includes unlimited transactions, payment processing, and dedicated business support. Rates start at 0.15% APY.
We offer payroll services, merchant processing, and invoice management tools. Get all business banking services in one platform.
Business loans up to $500,000 with flexible terms. Fast approval for qualified businesses. Call our business team: 1-800-BIZ-BANK.
For security, we may verify your identity during account setup using public records and security questions. This is standard banking practice.
If account verification is required, you'll receive instructions via email or SMS. Verification typically takes 24-48 hours.
For assistance with verification, call 1-888-SECURE-BANK with your ID ready. You may also visit any branch with government-issued ID.
For tax compliance, we may request Form W-9 or W-8BEN. This information determines tax treatment and IRS reporting for your accounts.
Foreign Account Tax Compliance Act (FATCA) requires reporting of certain international accounts. SecureBank is fully compliant.
If you're a U.S. person with foreign accounts, disclose all accounts. Contact our compliance team: compliance@securebank.com for questions.
